# Phase 1: ObongCMS Core Completion — Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Complete ObongCMS Go Edge to render all content types (halaman, galeri, slider, pengumuman) and build theme + widget systems.

**Architecture:** Go Edge reads JSON snapshots from filesystem (generated by CI4 Generator), renders via Go `html/template`. Theme system: folder switching with fallback to `default/`. Widget system: layout JSON rendered via partials.

**Tech Stack:** Go + Chi v5, `html/template`, existing `tenantfs` + `domainresolver` packages.

## Global Constraints

- All existing files stay as-is unless explicitly modified
- Go template functions: `safeHTML`, `unescape`, `escape`, `truncate`, `uppercase`, `lowercase`, `capitalize`, `default` (register all in base template)
- Template location: `templates/{theme_name}/{type}/index|detail.html`
- Tenant theme stored in `tenant.json` → `tema_id` field
- Widget layout stored in `setting.json` → `widget_layouts` array

Create `base/views/template.go`:

```go
package views

import (
	"html/template"
	"io"
	"path/filepath"
)

// ThemeEngine handles template rendering with theme fallback.
type ThemeEngine struct {
	templatesDir string // root templates/ directory
	funcs        template.FuncMap
}

func NewThemeEngine(templatesDir string) *ThemeEngine {
	return &ThemeEngine{
		templatesDir: templatesDir,
		funcs: template.FuncMap{
			"safeHTML":   func(s string) template.HTML { return template.HTML(s) },
			"unescape":   func(s string) template.HTML { return template.HTML(s) },
			"escape":     template.HTMLEscapeString,
			"truncate":   func(s string, n int) string { runes := []rune(s); if len(runes) > n { return string(runes[:n]) + "..." }; return s },
			"uppercase":  func(s string) string { return template.HTMLEscapeString(s) }, // placeholder, use strings.ToUpper
			"lowercase":  template.HTMLEscapeString,
			"capitalize": template.HTMLEscapeString,
			"default":    func(v, def string) string { if v == "" { return def }; return v },
		},
	}
}

// Render renders a template with theme-aware resolution.
// It tries themeName/templatePath first, falls back to default/templatePath.
func (e *ThemeEngine) Render(w io.Writer, themeName, templatePath string, data any) error {
	basePath := filepath.Join(e.templatesDir, "default", "base.html")
	targetPath := filepath.Join(e.templatesDir, themeName, templatePath)
	fallbackPath := filepath.Join(e.templatesDir, "default", templatePath)

	files := []string{basePath}
	// Try theme-specific template first
	if _, err := os.Stat(targetPath); err == nil {
		files = append(files, targetPath)
	} else {
		files = append(files, fallbackPath)
	}

	// Also check if theme has its own base.html
	themeBase := filepath.Join(e.templatesDir, themeName, "base.html")
	if _, err := os.Stat(themeBase); err == nil {
		// Theme has its own base, use it as base (don't override default base)
		// Actually prepend it
		files[0] = themeBase
	}

	tmpl, err := template.New("base.html").Funcs(e.funcs).ParseFiles(files...)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return tmpl.Execute(w, data)
}
```

But wait — I need to handle Go's `os.Stat` properly. Let me fix:

```go
package views

import (
	"html/template"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

// ThemeEngine handles template rendering with theme fallback.
type ThemeEngine struct {
	templatesDir string
	funcs        template.FuncMap
}

func NewThemeEngine(templatesDir string) *ThemeEngine {
	return &ThemeEngine{
		templatesDir: templatesDir,
		funcs: template.FuncMap{
			"safeHTML":   func(s string) template.HTML { return template.HTML(s) },
			"escape":     template.HTMLEscapeString,
			"truncate":   func(s string, n int) string { r := []rune(s); if len(r) > n { return string(r[:n]) + "..." }; return s },
			"uppercase":  strings.ToUpper,
			"lowercase":  strings.ToLower,
			"title":      strings.ToTitle,
			"default":    func(v, def string) string { if v == "" { return def }; return v },
			"add":        func(a, b int) int { return a + b },
			"sub":        func(a, b int) int { return a - b },
		},
	}
}

func (e *ThemeEngine) Render(w io.Writer, themeName, templatePath string, data any) error {
	baseDefault := filepath.Join(e.templatesDir, "default", "base.html")
	baseTheme := filepath.Join(e.templatesDir, themeName, "base.html")
	fileTheme := filepath.Join(e.templatesDir, themeName, templatePath)
	fileDefault := filepath.Join(e.templatesDir, "default", templatePath)

	var files []string
	if _, err := os.Stat(baseTheme); err == nil {
		files = append(files, baseTheme)
	} else {
		files = append(files, baseDefault)
	}

	if _, err := os.Stat(fileTheme); err == nil {
		files = append(files, fileTheme)
	} else {
		files = append(files, fileDefault)
	}

	tmpl, err := template.New("base.html").Funcs(e.funcs).ParseFiles(files...)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return tmpl.Execute(w, data)
}

func (e *ThemeEngine) ParseTemplate(themeName, templatePath string) (*template.Template, error) {
	baseDefault := filepath.Join(e.templatesDir, "default", "base.html")
	baseTheme := filepath.Join(e.templatesDir, themeName, "base.html")
	fileTheme := filepath.Join(e.templatesDir, themeName, templatePath)
	fileDefault := filepath.Join(e.templatesDir, "default", templatePath)

	var files []string
	if _, err := os.Stat(baseTheme); err == nil {
		files = append(files, baseTheme)
	} else {
		files = append(files, baseDefault)
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(fileTheme); err == nil {
		files = append(files, fileTheme)
	} else {
		files = append(files, fileDefault)
	}

	return template.New("base.html").Funcs(e.funcs).ParseFiles(files...)
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Update site Handler to use ThemeEngine**

Modify `modules/site/handler.go`:

```go
package site

import (
	"net/http"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/obong/obongcms-edge/base/views"
	"github.com/obong/obongcms-edge/internal/domainresolver"
	"github.com/obong/obongcms-edge/internal/tenantfs"
)

type Handler struct {
	tfs      *tenantfs.TenantFS
	resolver *domainresolver.Resolver
	engine   *views.ThemeEngine
}

func NewHandler(runtimePath string, resolver *domainresolver.Resolver) *Handler {
	return &Handler{
		tfs:    tenantfs.New(runtimePath),
		resolver: resolver,
		engine: views.NewThemeEngine("templates"),
	}
}

func (h *Handler) Routes() chi.Router {
	r := chi.NewRouter()
	r.Get("/", h.Home)
	r.Get("/berita", h.BeritaList)
	r.Get("/berita/{slug}", h.BeritaDetail)
	r.Get("/halaman/{slug}", h.HalamanDetail)
	r.Get("/pengumuman", h.PengumumanList)
	r.Get("/pengumuman/{slug}", h.PengumumanDetail)
	r.Get("/gallery", h.GaleriList)
	r.Handle("/assets/*", http.StripPrefix("/assets/", http.FileServer(http.Dir("public/assets"))))
	r.HandleFunc("/media/*", h.Media)
	return r
}

func (h *Handler) domain(r *http.Request) string {
	host := r.Host
	if idx := strings.Index(host, ":"); idx != -1 {
		host = host[:idx]
	}
	return host
}

func (h *Handler) domainReady(domain string) bool {
	if _, err := h.resolver.Resolve(domain); err == nil {
		return true
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(h.tfs.TenantDir(domain)); err == nil {
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func (h *Handler) tenantConfig(domain string) *domainresolver.TenantConfig {
	cfg, _ := h.resolver.Resolve(domain)
	return cfg
}

func (h *Handler) themeName(domain string) string {
	cfg := h.tenantConfig(domain)
	if cfg != nil && cfg.TemaID != "" {
		return cfg.TemaID
	}
	return "default"
}
```

```go
package site

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/obong/obongcms-edge/base/views"
	"github.com/obong/obongcms-edge/internal/domainresolver"
	"github.com/obong/obongcms-edge/internal/tenantfs"
)

type Handler struct {
	tfs      *tenantfs.TenantFS
	resolver *domainresolver.Resolver
	engine   *views.ThemeEngine
}

func NewHandler(runtimePath string, resolver *domainresolver.Resolver) *Handler {
	return &Handler{
		tfs:      tenantfs.New(runtimePath),
		resolver: resolver,
		engine:   views.NewThemeEngine("templates"),
	}
}

func (h *Handler) Routes() chi.Router {
	r := chi.NewRouter()
	r.Get("/", h.Home)
	r.Get("/berita", h.BeritaList)
	r.Get("/berita/{slug}", h.BeritaDetail)
	r.Get("/halaman/{slug}", h.HalamanDetail)
	r.Get("/pengumuman", h.PengumumanList)
	r.Get("/pengumuman/{slug}", h.PengumumanDetail)
	r.Get("/gallery", h.GaleriList)
	r.Handle("/assets/*", http.StripPrefix("/assets/", http.FileServer(http.Dir("public/assets"))))
	r.HandleFunc("/media/*", h.Media)
	return r
}

// --- Helpers ---

func (h *Handler) domain(r *http.Request) string {
	host := r.Host
	if idx := strings.Index(host, ":"); idx != -1 {
		host = host[:idx]
	}
	return host
}

func (h *Handler) domainReady(domain string) bool {
	if _, err := h.resolver.Resolve(domain); err == nil {
		return true
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(h.tfs.TenantDir(domain)); err == nil {
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func (h *Handler) tenantConfig(domain string) *domainresolver.TenantConfig {
	cfg, _ := h.resolver.Resolve(domain)
	return cfg
}

func (h *Handler) themeName(domain string) string {
	if cfg := h.tenantConfig(domain); cfg != nil && cfg.TemaID != "" {
		return cfg.TemaID
	}
	return "default"
}

// pageData constructs the full template context with setting + widgets.
func (h *Handler) pageData(domain, templatePath string, content any) map[string]any {
	var setting SettingData
	if err := h.tfs.ReadJSON(domain, "setting.json", &setting); err != nil {
		setting = SettingData{}
	}

	data := map[string]any{
		"domain":  domain,
		"setting": setting,
		"content": content,
		"theme":   h.themeName(domain),
		"isHome":  templatePath == "index.html",
	}

	// Parse widgets per position
	widgets := parseWidgets(setting.WidgetLayouts)
	data["widgets"] = widgets

	// Custom CSS/HTML
	if setting.CustomCSS != "" {
		data["custom_css"] = setting.CustomCSS
	}
	if setting.CustomHeader != "" {
		data["custom_header"] = setting.CustomHeader
	}
	if setting.CustomFooter != "" {
		data["custom_footer"] = setting.CustomFooter
	}

	return data
}

func (h *Handler) render(w http.ResponseWriter, domain, tmplPath string, content any) {
	theme := h.themeName(domain)
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
	if err := h.engine.Render(w, theme, tmplPath, h.pageData(domain, tmplPath, content)); err != nil {
		log.Printf("render error [%s/%s]: %v", theme, tmplPath, err)
		http.Error(w, "Template error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
	}
}

// --- Home ---

func (h *Handler) Home(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	domain := h.domain(r)
	if !h.domainReady(domain) {
		http.Error(w, "Domain tidak terdaftar", http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	// Coba render index.html, fallback ke berita
	var setting SettingData
	h.tfs.ReadJSON(domain, "setting.json", &setting)
	h.render(w, domain, "index.html", map[string]any{
		"setting": setting,
	})
}

// --- Berita ---

func (h *Handler) BeritaList(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	domain := h.domain(r)
	if !h.domainReady(domain) {
		http.Error(w, "Domain tidak terdaftar", http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	var listData BeritaListData
	if err := h.tfs.ReadJSON(domain, "berita.json", &listData); err != nil {
		listData = BeritaListData{Items: []BeritaItem{}}
	}
	h.render(w, domain, "berita/index.html", listData)
}

func (h *Handler) BeritaDetail(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	domain := h.domain(r)
	slug := chi.URLParam(r, "slug")
	if !h.domainReady(domain) {
		http.Error(w, "Domain tidak terdaftar", http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	var detail BeritaDetail
	if err := h.tfs.ReadJSON(domain, "berita/"+slug+".json", &detail); err != nil {
		http.NotFound(w, r)
		return
	}
	h.render(w, domain, "berita/detail.html", detail)
}

// --- Halaman ---

func (h *Handler) HalamanDetail(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	domain := h.domain(r)
	slug := chi.URLParam(r, "slug")
	if !h.domainReady(domain) {
		http.Error(w, "Domain tidak terdaftar", http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	var detail HalamanDetail
	if err := h.tfs.ReadJSON(domain, "halaman/"+slug+".json", &detail); err != nil {
		http.NotFound(w, r)
		return
	}
	h.render(w, domain, "halaman/detail.html", detail)
}

// --- Pengumuman ---

func (h *Handler) PengumumanList(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	domain := h.domain(r)
	if !h.domainReady(domain) {
		http.Error(w, "Domain tidak terdaftar", http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	var listData PengumumanListData
	if err := h.tfs.ReadJSON(domain, "pengumuman.json", &listData); err != nil {
		listData = PengumumanListData{Items: []PengumumanItem{}}
	}
	h.render(w, domain, "pengumuman/index.html", listData)
}

func (h *Handler) PengumumanDetail(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	domain := h.domain(r)
	slug := chi.URLParam(r, "slug")
	if !h.domainReady(domain) {
		http.Error(w, "Domain tidak terdaftar", http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	var detail PengumumanDetail
	if err := h.tfs.ReadJSON(domain, "pengumuman/"+slug+".json", &detail); err != nil {
		http.NotFound(w, r)
		return
	}
	h.render(w, domain, "pengumuman/detail.html", detail)
}

// --- Galeri ---

func (h *Handler) GaleriList(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	domain := h.domain(r)
	if !h.domainReady(domain) {
		http.Error(w, "Domain tidak terdaftar", http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	var listData GaleriListData
	if err := h.tfs.ReadJSON(domain, "galeri.json", &listData); err != nil {
		listData = GaleriListData{Items: []GaleriItem{}}
	}
	h.render(w, domain, "galeri/index.html", listData)
}

// --- Media ---

func (h *Handler) Media(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	domain := h.domain(r)
	if !h.domainReady(domain) {
		http.NotFound(w, r)
		return
	}
	rel := strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/")
	http.ServeFile(w, r, filepath.Join(h.tfs.TenantDir(domain), rel))
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Create widgets.go for widget parsing**

Create `modules/site/widgets.go`:

```go
package site

import "encoding/json"

// parseWidgets converts widget_layouts from setting.json into WidgetMap
// grouped by layout_name (position).
func parseWidgets(layouts []WidgetLayout) WidgetMap {
	wm := make(WidgetMap)
	for _, layout := range layouts {
		var widgets []map[string]any
		if err := json.Unmarshal(layout.Widgets, &widgets); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		wm[layout.LayoutName] = widgets
	}
	return wm
}
```

### Task 5: CI4 — Galeri Generator for Go Edge

- [ ] **Step 1: Add Galeri generator methods to Generator.php**

Append before the `syncAll` method:

```php
// ================================================================
// GALERI
// ================================================================

public static function galeri(int $tenantId, int $id): array
{
    $db  = Database::connect();
    $row = $db->table('cms_galeri')
        ->where('id', $id)->where('tenant_id', $tenantId)->where('deleted_at IS NULL')
        ->get()->getRowArray();

    if (! $row) {
        return [];
    }

    // Ambil foto galeri
    $fotoRows = $db->table('cms_media')
        ->where('galeri_id', $id)
        ->where('tenant_id', $tenantId)
        ->where('deleted_at IS NULL')
        ->orderBy('urutan', 'ASC')
        ->get()->getResultArray();

    $foto = [];
    foreach ($fotoRows as $f) {
        $foto[] = [
            'url'     => $f['url'] ?? '',
            'caption' => $f['caption'] ?? '',
            'urutan'  => (int) ($f['urutan'] ?? 0),
        ];
    }

    $detail = [
        'judul'     => $row['judul'],
        'deskripsi' => $row['deskripsi'] ?? '',
        'foto'      => $foto,
        'created_at' => $row['created_at'] ?? '',
    ];

    return array_merge(
        [['path' => 'galeri/' . $row['slug'] ?? $row['id'] . '.json', 'content' => json_encode(self::wrapEnvelope('galeri', null, null, $detail), JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE)]],
        self::syncGaleriIndex($tenantId),
    );
}

public static function syncGaleri(int $tenantId): array
{
    $db   = Database::connect();
    $rows = $db->table('cms_galeri')
        ->where('tenant_id', $tenantId)->where('deleted_at IS NULL')
        ->orderBy('created_at', 'DESC')->get()->getResultArray();

    $files = [];

    foreach ($rows as $row) {
        $fotoRows = $db->table('cms_media')
            ->where('galeri_id', $row['id'])
            ->where('tenant_id', $tenantId)
            ->where('deleted_at IS NULL')
            ->orderBy('urutan', 'ASC')
            ->get()->getResultArray();

        $foto = [];
        foreach ($fotoRows as $f) {
            $foto[] = [
                'url'     => $f['url'] ?? '',
                'caption' => $f['caption'] ?? '',
                'urutan'  => (int) ($f['urutan'] ?? 0),
            ];
        }

        $files[] = [
            'path'    => 'galeri/' . ($row['slug'] ?? $row['id']) . '.json',
            'content' => json_encode(self::wrapEnvelope('galeri', null, null, [
                'judul'     => $row['judul'],
                'deskripsi' => $row['deskripsi'] ?? '',
                'foto'      => $foto,
                'created_at' => $row['created_at'] ?? '',
            ]), JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE),
        ];
    }

    return array_merge($files, self::syncGaleriIndex($tenantId));
}

private static function syncGaleriIndex(int $tenantId): array
{
    $db   = Database::connect();
    $rows = $db->table('cms_galeri')
        ->where('tenant_id', $tenantId)->where('deleted_at IS NULL')
        ->orderBy('created_at', 'DESC')->get()->getResultArray();

    $items = [];
    foreach ($rows as $row) {
        $countFoto = $db->table('cms_media')
            ->where('galeri_id', $row['id'])
            ->where('tenant_id', $tenantId)
            ->where('deleted_at IS NULL')
            ->countAllResults();

        $items[] = [
            'slug'        => $row['slug'] ?? $row['id'],
            'judul'       => $row['judul'],
            'deskripsi'   => $row['deskripsi'] ?? '',
            'sampul'      => $row['sampul'] ?? '',
            'jumlah_foto' => $countFoto,
            'created_at'  => $row['created_at'] ?? '',
        ];
    }

    return [
        ['path' => 'galeri.json', 'content' => json_encode(self::wrapEnvelope('galeri', 'index', null, [
            'items'      => $items,
            'updated_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
        ]), JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE)],
    ];
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Redaksi\Widget\Controllers;

use Base\Controllers\BaseController;
use Base\Libraries\Permission;
use Base\Libraries\GoEdge;

class Widget extends BaseController
{
    public function index()
    {
        Permission::can('redaksi.tampilan.read');

        $widgetTypes = [
            ['type' => 'html', 'label' => 'HTML Custom', 'icon' => 'code'],
            ['type' => 'berita_terbaru', 'label' => 'Berita Terbaru', 'icon' => 'news'],
            ['type' => 'halaman', 'label' => 'Halaman', 'icon' => 'page'],
            ['type' => 'kategori', 'label' => 'Kategori', 'icon' => 'tag'],
            ['type' => 'galeri', 'label' => 'Galeri', 'icon' => 'image'],
            ['type' => 'menu', 'label' => 'Menu', 'icon' => 'menu'],
            ['type' => 'sosmed', 'label' => 'Sosial Media', 'icon' => 'share'],
            ['type' => 'pencarian', 'label' => 'Pencarian', 'icon' => 'search'],
            ['type' => 'jam', 'label' => 'Jam Digital', 'icon' => 'clock'],
            ['type' => 'kalender', 'label' => 'Kalender', 'icon' => 'calendar'],
            ['type' => 'statistik', 'label' => 'Statistik', 'icon' => 'chart'],
        ];

        return twig('@redaksi/widget/index', [
            'widget_types' => $widgetTypes,
        ]);
    }

    public function save()
    {
        Permission::can('redaksi.tampilan.upsert');

        $tenantId = $GLOBALS['access']['tenant_id'];
        $post     = $this->request->getJSON(true);

        if (! $post || ! isset($post['layouts'])) {
            return jsonError('Data tidak valid');
        }

        $db = db_connect();
        $db->table('cms_widget_layout')
            ->where('tenant_id', $tenantId)
            ->where('deleted_at IS NULL')
            ->delete();

        foreach ($post['layouts'] as $layout) {
            $db->table('cms_widget_layout')->insert([
                'tenant_id'   => $tenantId,
                'layout_name' => $layout['layout_name'],
                'widgets'     => json_encode($layout['widgets'] ?? [], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE),
                'created_at'  => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
            ]);
        }

        // Rebuild setting + kirim ke Go Edge
        $files = \Base\Libraries\Generator::syncSetting($tenantId);
        (new GoEdge())->publishContent(
            $GLOBALS['access']['domain'] ?? '',
            $files
        );

        return jsonSuccess('Widget berhasil disimpan');
    }

    public function load()
    {
        Permission::can('redaksi.tampilan.read');

        $tenantId = $GLOBALS['access']['tenant_id'];
        $db       = db_connect();
        $rows     = $db->table('cms_widget_layout')
            ->where('tenant_id', $tenantId)
            ->where('deleted_at IS NULL')
            ->orderBy('id', 'ASC')
            ->get()->getResultArray();

        $layouts = [];
        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $layouts[] = [
                'layout_name' => $row['layout_name'],
                'widgets'     => json_decode($row['widgets'], true) ?? [],
            ];
        }

        return jsonSuccess('ok', $layouts);
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Create Widget View (simple HTML/JS)**

Write `pages/redaksi/Widget/Views/index.html`:

```html
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}Widget Manager{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="card">
    <div class="card-header">
        <h3>Widget Manager</h3>
        <p class="text-muted">Atur widget di sidebar, footer, dan homepage.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="card-body">
        <div class="row mb-4">
            <div class="col-12">
                <select id="position-select" class="form-select w-auto">
                    <option value="sidebar">Sidebar</option>
                    <option value="footer">Footer</option>
                    <option value="homepage_top">Homepage Atas</option>
                    <option value="homepage_bottom">Homepage Bawah</option>
                </select>
                <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="addWidget()">+ Tambah Widget</button>
                <button class="btn btn-success" onclick="saveWidgets()">Simpan</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div id="widget-list" class="row">
            <div class="col-12 text-center text-muted py-5">
                Pilih posisi untuk mulai mengatur widget.
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="card mt-4">
    <div class="card-header">
        <h3>Tipe Widget</h3>
    </div>
    <div class="card-body">
        <div class="row g-3">
            {% for wt in widget_types %}
            <div class="col-md-3 col-6">
                <div class="border rounded p-3 text-center" onclick="addWidgetOfType('{{ wt.type }}')" style="cursor:pointer">
                    <div class="fw-bold">{{ wt.label }}</div>
                    <small class="text-muted">{{ wt.type }}</small>
                </div>
            </div>
            {% endfor %}
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}

{% block scripts %}
<script>
let currentPosition = 'sidebar';
let widgetData = { sidebar: [], footer: [], homepage_top: [], homepage_bottom: [] };

document.getElementById('position-select').addEventListener('change', function() {
    currentPosition = this.value;
    renderWidgets();
});

function renderWidgets() {
    const container = document.getElementById('widget-list');
    const widgets = widgetData[currentPosition] || [];
    if (widgets.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = '<div class="col-12 text-center text-muted py-5">Belum ada widget di posisi ini.</div>';
        return;
    }
    let html = '';
    widgets.forEach((w, i) => {
        html += `<div class="col-md-6 mb-3">
            <div class="border rounded p-3">
                <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center">
                    <strong>${w.title || w.type}</strong>
                    <button class="btn btn-sm btn-danger" onclick="removeWidget(${i})">Hapus</button>
                </div>
                <small class="text-muted">${w.type}</small>
            </div>
        </div>`;
    });
    container.innerHTML = html;
}

function addWidget() {
    widgetData[currentPosition] = widgetData[currentPosition] || [];
    widgetData[currentPosition].push({ type: 'html', title: 'Widget Baru', content: '' });
    renderWidgets();
}

function addWidgetOfType(type) {
    widgetData[currentPosition] = widgetData[currentPosition] || [];
    const titles = { html: 'HTML Custom', berita_terbaru: 'Berita Terbaru', halaman: 'Halaman',
        kategori: 'Kategori', galeri: 'Galeri', menu: 'Menu', sosmed: 'Sosial Media',
        pencarian: 'Pencarian', jam: 'Jam Digital', kalender: 'Kalender', statistik: 'Statistik' };
    widgetData[currentPosition].push({ type: type, title: titles[type] || type, limit: 5 });
    renderWidgets();
}

function removeWidget(index) {
    widgetData[currentPosition].splice(index, 1);
    renderWidgets();
}

function saveWidgets() {
    const layouts = Object.entries(widgetData).map(([layout_name, widgets]) => ({ layout_name, widgets }));
    $.fn.PostForm({
        url: '{{ base_url }}redaksi/widget/save',
        data: JSON.stringify({ layouts }),
        contentType: 'application/json',
        success: function() { alert('Widget disimpan!'); }
    });
}

function loadWidgets() {
    $.fn.PostForm({
        url: '{{ base_url }}redaksi/widget/load',
        success: function(res) {
            if (res.status && res.data) {
                widgetData = { sidebar: [], footer: [], homepage_top: [], homepage_bottom: [] };
                res.data.forEach(l => { widgetData[l.layout_name] = l.widgets; });
                renderWidgets();
            }
        }
    });
}

$(document).ready(loadWidgets);
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

- [ ] **Step 1: Create Tampilan controller**

Write `pages/redaksi/Tampilan/Controllers/Tampilan.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace Redaksi\Tampilan\Controllers;

use Base\Controllers\BaseController;
use Base\Libraries\Permission;
use Base\Libraries\GoEdge;
use Base\Libraries\Generator;

class Tampilan extends BaseController
{
    public function index()
    {
        Permission::can('redaksi.tampilan.read');

        $tenantId = $GLOBALS['access']['tenant_id'];
        $domain   = $GLOBALS['access']['domain'] ?? '';

        // Ambil tema saat ini
        $db   = db_connect();
        $tema = $db->table('cms_tema_config')
            ->where('tenant_id', $tenantId)
            ->get()->getRowArray();

        // Daftar tema tersedia (hardcoded — bisa diganti via config nanti)
        $themes = [
            ['id' => 'default', 'name' => 'Default', 'tier' => 'free', 'screenshot' => ''],
            ['id' => 'modern', 'name' => 'Modern', 'tier' => 'free', 'screenshot' => ''],
        ];

        return twig('@redaksi/tampilan/index', [
            'current_theme' => $tema['tema'] ?? 'default',
            'themes'        => $themes,
        ]);
    }

    public function setTheme()
    {
        Permission::can('redaksi.tampilan.upsert');

        $tenantId = $GLOBALS['access']['tenant_id'];
        $domain   = $GLOBALS['access']['domain'] ?? '';
        $theme    = $this->request->getPost('theme') ?? 'default';

        $db = db_connect();
        $db->table('cms_tema_config')
            ->where('tenant_id', $tenantId)
            ->delete();

        $db->table('cms_tema_config')->insert([
            'tenant_id'  => $tenantId,
            'tema'       => $theme,
            'created_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
        ]);

        // Update tenant.tema_id
        $db->table('app_tenants')
            ->where('id', $tenantId)
            ->update(['tema_id' => $theme]);

        // Rebuild setting + sync ke Go Edge
        $files = Generator::syncSetting($tenantId);
        (new GoEdge())->publishContent($domain, $files);

        return jsonSuccess('Tema berhasil diubah');
    }

    public function custom()
    {
        Permission::can('redaksi.tampilan.read');

        $tenantId = $GLOBALS['access']['tenant_id'];
        $db       = db_connect();

        $customCss    = $db->table('app_settings')->where('tenant_id', $tenantId)->where('key_name', 'custom_css')->get()->getRowArray();
        $customHeader = $db->table('app_settings')->where('tenant_id', $tenantId)->where('key_name', 'custom_header')->get()->getRowArray();
        $customFooter = $db->table('app_settings')->where('tenant_id', $tenantId)->where('key_name', 'custom_footer')->get()->getRowArray();

        return twig('@redaksi/tampilan/setting', [
            'custom_css'    => $customCss['key_value'] ?? '',
            'custom_header' => $customHeader['key_value'] ?? '',
            'custom_footer' => $customFooter['key_value'] ?? '',
        ]);
    }

    public function saveCustom()
    {
        Permission::can('redaksi.tampilan.upsert');

        $tenantId = $GLOBALS['access']['tenant_id'];
        $domain   = $GLOBALS['access']['domain'] ?? '';

        $keys = ['custom_css', 'custom_header', 'custom_footer'];
        foreach ($keys as $key) {
            $value = $this->request->getPost($key) ?? '';

            $db = db_connect();
            $existing = $db->table('app_settings')
                ->where('tenant_id', $tenantId)
                ->where('key_name', $key)
                ->get()->getRowArray();

            if ($existing) {
                $db->table('app_settings')
                    ->where('id', $existing['id'])
                    ->update(['key_value' => $value]);
            } else {
                $db->table('app_settings')->insert([
                    'tenant_id'  => $tenantId,
                    'key_name'   => $key,
                    'key_value'  => $value,
                    'created_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
                ]);
            }
        }

        // Rebuild + sync
        $files = Generator::syncSetting($tenantId);
        (new GoEdge())->publishContent($domain, $files);

        return jsonSuccess('Pengaturan tampilan disimpan');
    }
}
```

```html
        <h3>Tema Website</h3>
    </div>
    <div class="card-body">
        <div class="row g-4">
            {% for theme in themes %}
            <div class="col-md-4">
                <div class="card {% if theme.id == current_theme %}border-primary{% endif %}">
                    {% if theme.screenshot %}
                    <img src="{{ theme.screenshot }}" class="card-img-top" alt="{{ theme.name }}">
                    {% else %}
                    <div class="card-img-top bg-light text-center py-5 text-muted">{{ theme.name }}</div>
                    {% endif %}
                    <div class="card-body">
                        <h5 class="card-title">{{ theme.name }}</h5>
                        <span class="badge bg-{{ 'success' if theme.tier == 'free' else 'warning' }}">
                            {{ theme.tier }}
                        </span>
                        {% if theme.id == current_theme %}
                        <span class="badge bg-primary">Aktif</span>
                        {% else %}
                        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary mt-2" onclick="setTheme('{{ theme.id }}')">
                            Aktifkan
                        </button>
                        {% endif %}
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            {% endfor %}
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="card mt-4">
    <div class="card-header">
        <h3>Custom CSS & HTML</h3>
    </div>
    <div class="card-body">
        <a href="{{ base_url }}redaksi/tampilan/custom" class="btn btn-primary">
            Atur CSS & HTML Kustom
        </a>
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}

{% block scripts %}
<script>
function setTheme(theme) {
    $.fn.PostForm({
        url: '{{ base_url }}redaksi/tampilan/setTheme',
        data: { theme: theme },
        success: function() { location.reload(); }
    });
}
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Create Custom CSS/HTML view**

Write `pages/redaksi/Tampilan/Views/setting.html`:

```html
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}Custom CSS & HTML{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="card">
    <div class="card-header">
        <h3>Custom CSS</h3>
    </div>
    <div class="card-body">
        <textarea class="form-control font-monospace" rows="8" id="custom_css" name="custom_css">{{ custom_css }}</textarea>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="card mt-3">
    <div class="card-header">
        <h3>Custom Header HTML</h3>
    </div>
    <div class="card-body">
        <textarea class="form-control font-monospace" rows="6" id="custom_header" name="custom_header">{{ custom_header }}</textarea>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="card mt-3">
    <div class="card-header">
        <h3>Custom Footer HTML</h3>
    </div>
    <div class="card-body">
        <textarea class="form-control font-monospace" rows="6" id="custom_footer" name="custom_footer">{{ custom_footer }}</textarea>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="mt-3">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="saveCustom()">Simpan</button>
    <a href="{{ base_url }}redaksi/tampilan" class="btn btn-secondary">Kembali</a>
</div>
{% endblock %}

{% block scripts %}
<script>
function saveCustom() {
    $.fn.PostForm({
        url: '{{ base_url }}redaksi/tampilan/saveCustom',
        data: {
            custom_css: $('#custom_css').val(),
            custom_header: $('#custom_header').val(),
            custom_footer: $('#custom_footer').val()
        },
        success: function() { alert('Disimpan!'); }
    });
}
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Add Tampilan routes**

Ensure routes in `pages/redaksi/Tampilan/Config/Routes.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace Redaksi\Tampilan\Config;

use CodeIgniter\Router\RouteCollection;

/** @var RouteCollection $routes */
$routes->group('redaksi/tampilan', ['namespace' => 'Redaksi\Tampilan\Controllers'], function ($r) {
    $r->get('', 'Tampilan::index');
    $r->post('setTheme', 'Tampilan::setTheme');
    $r->get('custom', 'Tampilan::custom');
    $r->post('saveCustom', 'Tampilan::saveCustom');
});
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Commit**

```bash
git -C obongcms/backend add pages/redaksi/Tampilan/
git -C obongcms/backend commit -m "feat: theme selector and custom CSS/HTML for tenant"
```
